site.name: FieldhouseUSA Aurora
specs: 8 hardwood, 2 sport-court and 3 turf volleyball courts
4 basketball courts with 8 hoops and 4 electronic scoreboards
90 × 80 ft turf for soccer and futsal
Yoga studio, sprung dance floor and carpet dance floor
Free on-site parking and a direct mall entrance

exterior.title: Step inside the field house.
exterior.lede: 15 courts, two studios, a restaurant and a mall entrance under one roof. Walk the building, pick a zone, and we send you to whoever runs it.

lobby.title: Which way?
lobby.sub: You're at the front desk. Three ways to go.

sells.title: Host an event
sells.lede: Birthdays on Saturday nights, corporate days on weekdays, galas and fundraisers whenever the floor is clear. Event-Den books the space; food and the bar come from Oda Up.
points: Corporate off-sites with the courts as part of the agenda
Holiday parties and galas with a licensed bar
Fundraisers and community events for up to the whole building

sells.title: Rent the floor
sells.lede: Courts, turf and studios by the hour, the day or the weekend. Practices, camps, clinics, film shoots and private games.
points: 15 courts across seven zones, plus two studios
Free parking, restrooms by every wing, restaurant on site

sells.title: Run a tournament
sells.lede: Tournament directors book the whole building: hardwood, sport and turf courts, scoreboards, seating and a restaurant under one roof. Plan about six months out.
points: USAV Rocky Mountain Region sanctioned events run here
Rental agreement signed and paid before event day
Check-in at the office, coaches' meeting at 7:30 AM

wings.name: West wing
wings.sub: Courts 1–8, the office and the Shoot 360 lab

wings.name: Straight ahead
wings.sub: Oda Up, the studios, Social-Den and courts 11–12

areas.name: Front desk & office

areas.blurb: Tracked shooting bays and a skills court. Every shot is measured; memberships and sessions run through Shoot 360 Denver.

areas.name: Zone 1
areas.blurb: First courts on your left past the office. Volleyball, pickleball or basketball depending on the day's schedule.
what: Pairs with Zone 2 for four-court events

areas.name: Zone 2

areas.name: Zone 3

what: Drop-in volleyball on a weekly schedule

areas.name: Zone 4

areas.name: Oda Up
areas.blurb: The restaurant and bar at the heart of the floor, with courtside seating. Outside food stays out; alcohol stays in the bar seating.

areas.name: Social-Den

areas.name: Dance-Den

areas.name: Yoga-Den

areas.name: Zone 6
areas.blurb: Right of the main aisle, beside Oda Up. Queens Club courts 3 and 4, with seating from the restaurant.

areas.name: Mezzanine

inquiries.label: Rent courts, turf or a studio

faq.q: Are you a city rec center?
faq.a: No. FieldhouseUSA is a private sports facility, so pricing is not in line with schools or rec centers. The municipal option is the Aurora Southeast Recreation Center.
Hours follow the day's programs and events. Check the drop-in schedule or your event confirmation before you come.
Yes, free and plentiful on site. It is an active lot, so lock your car and keep valuables out of sight.

faq.q: Can I bring food or drink?
faq.a: No outside food or drink, including coffee. Oda Up serves food and drinks inside. Catering for events goes through Event-Den.

faq.q: Can I rent a single court for a few hours?
faq.a: Sometimes. Individual court rental is limited and priced at event-day rates. Send a rental request with the date and we will tell you what is open.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book a tournament?
faq.a: About six months. A rental agreement has to be signed and paid in full before the event.

faq.q: Is there a lost and found?
faq.a: No. Items left behind are cleared nightly. Keep electronics and valuables with you.
Yes, with written notice at least 12 hours ahead. Service animals stay off the playing surfaces.

rules.intro: Boomtown FieldhouseUSA is a private facility. By entering you accept these rules and the waiver terms, players and spectators alike. Photos and video taken in the facility may be used in marketing; cameras and staff monitor the building.

sections.title: Before you enter
items: We may refuse entry or ask anyone to leave for any reason. You enter at your own risk.

Boomtown provides the venue only and is not responsible for the organization of external tournaments or events, or for injuries, damages or losses during them. Contact your tournament organizer with event questions.

sections.title: Bags and weapons
items: No weapons or firearms of any kind.
Only player backpacks are allowed inside. Purses and camera bags are permitted but must be open for a quick check.

sections.title: Food and drink
items: No outside commercial food or drink, including coffee. No coolers of food.
No gum. No sports drinks, coffee or tea in playing areas.
Only sealed, clear water on the courts. No Stanley or uncapped cups.
No eating or snacks on the courts. A bar and café is on site; all alcohol stays in the bar seating area.
If you bring outside food, eat it inside your vehicle.

sections.title: Courts and equipment
items: Don't climb nets, fences or sprinklers, stand on tables or bar tops, or enter non-play areas. Offenders pay for damages.
No personal chairs, camping chairs, coolers or self-carried team tables on the courts. Don't move court chairs.
Floor mats and seats are fine if they don't scratch the floor. Movable spectator chairs are first come, first served; please return them.
No ball handling or play, including dribbling or throwing, outside authorized event areas.
Clean spills immediately; the responsible team stops play to clean up. Each team must clean its area after playing or be fined.

sections.title: Kids and restricted areas
items: Children must be supervised at all times or will be asked to leave.
Stay out of other athletic or under-construction areas: soccer field, lounge, med-spa, gymnastics and dance studios.

sections.title: Pets
items: No animals except service animals as defined by law. Please give at least 12 hours' written notice.
Service animals are kept off all playing surfaces and activity areas.

sections.title: First aid and power
items: There is no athletic trainer or ice on site; bring your own. First-aid kits and bandages can be purchased for a fee.
No appliances may be plugged in. Phone charging is allowed around the bar areas only.

sections.title: Parking and out front
items: Parking is free and plentiful, but we are not responsible for your vehicle. Lock it and keep valuables out of sight.
No tables, camping or tailgating in front of the building (Aurora camping ban; other businesses operate here). Unattended items are removed.

sections.title: Lost and found
items: There is no lost and found. Unclaimed items are disposed of nightly for sanitation. Lost electronics and valuables are not our responsibility. Please don't call or email about lost items.

sections.title: USAV RMR events
items: RMR players only may bring a brown-bag lunch carried in a player backpack; if it doesn't fit in the backpack, it isn't allowed. Spectators may not bring bags (except purses and camera bags) or food.
Doors open at 7:00 AM; team areas are first come, first served. Coaches' meeting is at 7:30 AM at the admin desk.
Warm-up balls and carts are not provided; RMR provides one game ball per court. Guest Wi-Fi is available.
A limited number of court-approved folding chairs are provided. Return them to the rack at the end.
Coaches and directors must check out with the site director before leaving or final scores won't be entered (automatic forfeit).

sections.title: Spectators and fines
items: Spectators who refuse to comply will be asked to leave or escorted out by APD, and must supervise their own children.
1st offense: $25 to the offending team or club. 2nd: $50. 3rd: the team forfeits its remaining matches and is not welcomed back.
Keep team belongings in your team area and out of the play space; clean up your area after you play, even if the trash isn't yours.
